Hi, I'm João Pedro Rocha, a Masters Student of Scientific Computing at LNCC
(National Laboratory for Scientific Computing, 🇧🇷).

I have a Physics background and am now developing research in Scientific
Machine Learning, with Neural Surrogates applied to build Digital Twins
for the energy industry.

I also do some work with Astrophysical data processing, mainly photometrical
time series, acquired with the telescopes managed by the LNA (National Astrophysics
Laboratory, also 🇧🇷).

Here i share about the stuff i learn along the way so that who are interested
can take advantage from it and we can learn together.

Here you will find:

- [TIL](til.qmd): Nuggets of knowledge learned on a given day.
- [Projects](projects.qmd): Some info about the projects I'm currently in.
- [Blog](blog.qmd): Long form knowledge nugget.
